audit.title: Cloud, platform, and advanced command parity audit
audit.scope: Source-only comparison of cloud, VM, account, VPN, mobile, Simulator/iOS, diagnostics, resource, capture, privilege, tmux compatibility, distribution, localization, and reliability contracts.
audit.evidence_boundary: Source, source tests, docs, and workflow definitions only. No build, native run, deployed authentication, production database, provider, VM, relay, VPN, Simulator, capture, sudo, update, or resource-soak journey was executed.
audit.provenance: Behavioral comparison only; no upstream implementation or assets are imported or translated.

status_definitions.source-verified-subset: A narrow zmux behavior exists and has focused source tests at the pinned SHA; native, packaged, hosted, authenticated, provider, and production evidence remain open.
status_definitions.partial: Some foundation exists, but the full user journey or required invariants are incomplete.
status_definitions.missing: No zmux behavioral owner for the audited contract was found.
status_definitions.fully-verified: All applicable contract, shared-owner, public CLI, packaged native, remote or cloud, and measured stability layers passed on the exact SHA. No audited family has this status.

summary.conclusion: Zmux has an identity and owner-scoped device foundation, not a cloud terminal product. Its readiness route reports vm, relay, and email unavailable, its native UI reports remote transport unavailable, and its CLI exposes no audited cloud or platform namespace.

global_contracts.cloud_alias: cmux cloud aliases the complete vm dispatcher; every nested leaf, alias, option, default, effect, target rule, output, and failure remains independently required.
global_contracts.completion_rule: A help line, parser branch, mock result, local same-name primitive, or explicit unavailable response does not establish behavioral parity.
global_contracts.remote_failure_rule: A failed, timed-out, or unavailable remote request must never execute locally.
global_contracts.relay_policy: Remote socket methods must deny by default, scope selectors to session-owned objects, reject command-bearing parameters unless explicitly reviewed, and withhold spawn or respawn until two-host execution identity is proven.
global_contracts.deployment_dependency: Provider and database selection blocks deployed VM journeys but does not remove them from scope or change their status to implemented.
global_contracts.distribution_boundary: An undeployed control-plane image receipt and an ad hoc-signed development app are separate artifacts and do not prove a production release or live sign-in.

feature_families.name: Deployment configuration and owned origin
feature_families.cmux_contract: Runtime destinations and generated platform inputs derive from validated configuration; unavailable owned services fail explicitly without an upstream fallback.
feature_families.target_resolution: One configured Zmux authority at https://zmux.w3dev.app; localhost HTTP is development-only.
preconditions: host, provider, database, secrets, and protected environment selected
feature_families.effects: Current workflow packages an image and receipt but does not deploy it.
feature_families.focus_policy: not applicable
feature_families.output_exit: Configuration validation must reject inconsistent origins; readiness must distinguish unavailable dependencies.
acceptance: native, web, callback, and release values agree
protected migration rehearsal succeeds on a disposable database
missing service has no operational upstream fallback
feature_families.evidence_limit: No deployment or migration was run.

feature_families.name: Native authentication and session binding
feature_families.cmux_contract: Native authorization binds client, redirect, state, verifier, user, and live web session; tokens are never handed off in URLs or logs.
feature_families.target_resolution: Current macOS development client and exact zmux-dev callback only.
feature_families.effects: Creates and consumes a bounded authorization code, stores a hashed session-bound token, and stores the native token in Keychain.
feature_families.focus_policy: Browser authorization may activate the login flow; callback must attach only to the initiating attempt.
feature_families.output_exit: Invalid state, verifier, callback, replay, expired session, redirect, or token fails without disclosing credentials.
acceptance: separate macOS and iOS client identities and keychains
no token in URL or log
feature_families.evidence_limit: Focused source tests exist; no packaged or deployed sign-in was run.

feature_families.name: Organizations, CLI teams, MFA, mail, and admin invariants
aliases_defaults: team invitations is the current-user pending list
account and auth routes share the current session authority
feature_families.cmux_contract: CLI, native, and service membership share one authority; current session and current membership are checked for every protected action.
feature_families.target_resolution: Current authenticated user and selected organization or explicit team.
preconditions: role and plan capacity where applicable
feature_families.effects: Zmux currently returns organization membership only; it has no CLI team surface or complete invitation/admin workflow.
feature_families.focus_policy: not applicable
feature_families.output_exit: Unauthorized, removed-member, stale invitation, capacity, last-admin, and concurrent update cases must be distinct and failure-visible.
feature_families.evidence_limit: Organization readback is tested; the broader matrix is not implemented.

feature_families.name: Billing and entitlement enforcement
feature_families.cmux_contract: Billing state authorizes resource creation and growth; client preflight and server enforcement agree, and durable entitlements are reconciled idempotently.
zmux_evidence: No billing, Stripe, entitlement, or VM plan owner found.
feature_families.target_resolution: Authenticated personal or team billing owner.
feature_families.focus_policy: Browser checkout and portal activation must be explicit.
feature_families.output_exit: Payment, cancellation, stale webhook, ownership, and capacity failures remain visible and idempotent.

feature_families.name: Device registry and presence foundation
feature_families.cmux_contract: Only the owner can observe or mutate a device; presence is bounded and connected to session and relay identity.
feature_families.target_resolution: Authenticated user owns the device UUID.
feature_families.effects: Register/list/heartbeat/revoke exist and are source-tested; no relay transport or cleanup job exists.
feature_families.focus_policy: not applicable
feature_families.output_exit: Cross-owner and revoked-device mutation fail without disclosing existence beyond the defined error contract.
feature_families.evidence_limit: Source tests cover the narrow registry; no packaged presence or relay journey was run.

feature_families.name: VM control plane, provider lifecycle, and readiness
feature_families.cmux_contract: Authenticated owner-scoped lifecycle with durable state, plan and pool checks, provider-confirmed resources, and explicit capability readiness.
zmux_evidence: services/control-plane/src/app.ts:268 reports vm and relay unavailable
feature_families.target_resolution: Authenticated owner or authorized team and canonical machine ID or slug.
feature_families.focus_policy: Open-like verbs accept focus or no-focus; detach creates without opening.
feature_families.output_exit: Provider, plan, capacity, image, ownership, unavailable, timeout, and uncertain mutation states must be distinct.
acceptance: readiness stays disabled until owned artifacts pass
feature_families.evidence_limit: No zmux VM service or provider owner found.

feature_families.name: VM remote workspace and terminal operations
feature_families.cmux_contract: Remote daemon identities distinguish workspace, terminal process, retained output, and tab placement; close detaches while rm kills; commands operate headlessly without unintended focus.
feature_families.target_resolution: Machine plus remote workspace, terminal, or tab ID; open additionally resolves local placement and focus.
feature_families.effects: missing; local send-text and read-screen do not target a remote daemon.
feature_families.focus_policy: Headless send/read/wait never focus; workspace open/new honor focus/no-focus and explicit local placement.
feature_families.output_exit: Regex timeout, pending process, exit code, signal, retained-output offsets, stale IDs, and transport loss are distinct.
feature_families.evidence_limit: No remote workspace or terminal owner found.

feature_families.name: VM layout and secret environment
feature_families.cmux_contract: Portable layouts validate before mutation and preserve geometry; environment values use an end-to-end machine link rather than control-plane plaintext exec and are hidden by default.
zmux_evidence: No remote layout document or environment delivery owner found.
feature_families.target_resolution: Machine and focused, named, or explicit remote workspace; environment is machine-wide.
feature_families.focus_policy: Layout apply opens only with --open; environment operations never focus.
feature_families.output_exit: Invalid document exits separately before mutation; environment output names only unless --show is explicit.

feature_families.name: VM networking, domains, snapshots, and templates
feature_families.cmux_contract: Live egress policy, verified publication ownership and access grants, and provider-backed durable snapshots preserve owner/team boundaries.
zmux_evidence: No network, publication, snapshot, fork, restore, or template owner found.
feature_families.target_resolution: Owned machine, verified domain or generated hostname, port publication, team or personal access, and provider snapshot ID.
feature_families.focus_policy: Fork and restore honor focus/no-focus/detach; other operations are headless.
feature_families.output_exit: Public exposure requires explicit confirmation; policy, DNS, grant, provider, and ownership failures remain distinct.

feature_families.name: VM execution, routing, agent, development, and transfer
feature_families.cmux_contract: Commands and bytes execute or transfer on the selected remote host with durable identity, exact argv/path handling, exit propagation, progress/cancel behavior, and no local fallback.
zmux_evidence: No remote exec, route, agent, development composition, or file transfer owner found.
feature_families.target_resolution: Explicit machine or route by cwd; agent additionally owns remote workspace and terminal identity; transfer owns local and remote paths.
feature_families.focus_policy: Headless exec/run/route/transfer do not focus; agent/dev honor open and focus flags.
feature_families.output_exit: Remote exit codes pass through; timeouts and uncertain mutation state are explicit; route dry-run does not execute; transfer progress and cancellation are observable.
acceptance: secret path bypasses readable control plane

feature_families.name: VM access, desktop, TUI, ports, and handoff
feature_families.cmux_contract: Addressable remote sessions and services reuse existing ownership, support explicit local placement/focus, and expose private URLs and connection details without making ports public.
zmux_evidence: apps/macos/Sources/CloudSettings.swift:234 says remote terminal transport is unavailable
feature_families.target_resolution: Tree address or machine plus remote workspace/terminal/desktop/port and local window/workspace placement.
feature_families.focus_policy: Open-like commands accept focus/no-focus; --print returns a URL without opening.
feature_families.output_exit: Stale addresses, missing capability, ownership, enrollment, and transport failures are explicit.

feature_families.name: System VPN Network Extension
feature_families.cmux_contract: A signed Network Extension provides other apps a system route while cmux terminals use a separate user-space WireGuard path; user approval is required and sudo is not a fallback.
zmux_evidence: No Network Extension target, entitlement, tunnel API, approval UI, or vpn CLI found.
feature_families.target_resolution: Current signed app installation and registered device.
feature_families.focus_policy: Approval UI may activate; status/down/revoke are headless.
feature_families.output_exit: Unavailable extension, denied approval, route failure, revoked device, and already-up/down states are distinct.

feature_families.name: Mobile settings and iOS client
feature_families.cmux_contract: Mobile compatibility settings use shared targeting and persistence; iOS has a distinct bundle/keychain/callback and reliable authenticated remote sessions.
zmux_evidence: No iOS app target, mobile identity, callback, remote client, or distribution lane found.
feature_families.target_resolution: Surface/workspace for font; current compatible-tag set; selected mobile account/device/session.
feature_families.focus_policy: Settings are headless; mobile UI owns foreground selection.
feature_families.output_exit: Invalid ranges/tags, wrong callback, revoked session/device, and incompatible server versions fail explicitly.

feature_families.name: Simulator and iOS command namespaces
feature_families.cmux_contract: Commands target a Simulator surface, wait for correlated worker or inspector results, preserve ordered input, and bind selected device and inspector sessions exactly.
zmux_evidence: No Simulator worker, iOS namespace, inspector bridge, or screenshot owner found.
feature_families.target_resolution: Explicit or caller Simulator surface; iOS list may scope workspace; context/select bind device UDID; screenshot supports one or all up to eight.
feature_families.focus_policy: Automation targets exact surfaces without unrelated app activation unless the command explicitly selects UI.
feature_families.output_exit: Correlation timeout, stale target, invalid touch sequence, missing permission/app/device, and inspector detach are distinct.

feature_families.name: Diagnostics, capabilities, and raw RPC security
feature_families.cmux_contract: Diagnostics are typed, bounded, honest about transport, and authorization-aware; generic RPC does not bypass method or object policy.
zmux_evidence: apps/cli/src/main.rs:681 implements only a local socket/protocol doctor
feature_families.target_resolution: Local app socket and explicit authorized method/object selectors.
preconditions: test-build or explicit gate for simulation
feature_families.focus_policy: Diagnostics do not focus; explicit simulation commands may change modeled focus only under test gating.
feature_families.output_exit: Connection, protocol, unsupported capability, authorization, timeout, and transport diagnostics remain distinct.
feature_families.evidence_limit: Doctor is not parity with the broader family.

feature_families.name: Resource and process inspection
aliases_defaults: memory defaults to 12 child command groups
feature_families.cmux_contract: CPU, physical footprint, process count, child RSS, and WebKit content processes are attributed without double-counting to windows, workspaces, panes, surfaces, tags, and browser views.
zmux_evidence: Local status reports counts and session state only; no process attribution or budget owner found.
feature_families.target_resolution: Current or all windows and optional workspace; process ownership follows live surface and WebKit identities.
feature_families.focus_policy: headless
feature_families.output_exit: Racing and exited PIDs are handled without misattribution; TSV and JSON schemas remain stable.
feature_families.evidence_limit: No implementation or native measurement found.

feature_families.name: Window capture and recording
feature_families.cmux_contract: Only owned app windows are captured without Screen Recording permission; format, scale, dimensions, region, output, caption, duration, and single-recording ownership are validated.
zmux_evidence: Workflow screenshots exist only as test harness artifacts; no public capture or recording command owner found.
feature_families.target_resolution: Explicit window or frontmost owned window; record ID for stop/status/note.
feature_families.focus_policy: Capture must not activate a different window as a side effect.
feature_families.output_exit: Invalid region/format/range/path, no window, conflicting recording, close, encode failure, and auto-stop are distinct.

feature_families.name: Privileged execution and Touch ID
feature_families.cmux_contract: A signed helper and broker authenticate the requester, bound command/script/stdin, reason, timeout, approval, and Touch ID flow without shell interpolation or silent privilege fallback.
zmux_evidence: No helper, broker, requester identity, sudo namespace, or Touch ID setup found.
feature_families.target_resolution: Current signed installation and authenticated local requester.
feature_families.focus_policy: Approval UI may activate; pending/status paths are headless.
feature_families.output_exit: Identity mismatch, denial, timeout, cancellation, malformed input, helper mismatch, and command exit remain distinct.

feature_families.name: Tmux compatibility commands
feature_families.cmux_contract: Implemented commands share topology, focus, terminal text, buffer, and hook owners with native behavior; unsupported placeholders fail honestly.
feature_families.target_resolution: Typed window/workspace/pane/surface refs and caller defaults; buffer name or synchronization token where applicable.
preconditions: shared topology and terminal text owners
feature_families.focus_policy: Swap/break/join explicitly control focus; navigation selects; capture/buffer/wait paths do not focus.
feature_families.output_exit: Exact bytes, bracketed paste, synchronization timeout, hook failure, command execution, and unsupported placeholder errors remain distinct.

feature_families.name: Feedback, welcome, onboarding, and update UX
aliases_defaults: feedback with no args opens the shared modal
welcome auto-runs once on first launch
sendFeedback is the shared UI action
feature_families.cmux_contract: CLI and UI feedback use one pipeline; draft opening is separate from external submission; first-run and permission onboarding are durable and re-enterable; update actions share a signed release authority.
zmux_evidence: No feedback submission pipeline, first-launch welcome/onboarding coordinator, updater, check-for-updates action, or release-note owner found.
feature_families.target_resolution: Feedback modal prefers the caller workspace without activating another context; updater and onboarding target the current installation and permission state.
preconditions: running app for feedback and UI flows
explicit user authorization before external submission
feature_families.focus_policy: Opening feedback or onboarding may activate its intended window; caller-workspace feedback can open without activating another workspace. Background update checks do not steal focus.
feature_families.output_exit: Unknown feedback flags, missing email/body, invalid or sensitive attachments, network/retry ambiguity, denied permissions, stale update metadata, signature mismatch, and no-update states remain distinct.
acceptance: explicit user approval and secret review before send
one-shot welcome persistence and manual reopen
feature_families.evidence_limit: No equivalent zmux owner found; no external submission or update check was run.

feature_families.name: Distribution, update, and CLI installation
feature_families.cmux_contract: Published artifacts have the intended bundle, callback, channel, signature, architecture, update provenance, and safe CLI installation behavior.
feature_families.target_resolution: Named release channel and signed application installation; user-selected writable PATH directory for the CLI.
feature_families.effects: Current source builds a universal ad hoc-signed development app; CLI install creates a symlink and refuses overwrite.
feature_families.focus_policy: Install/update UI requires explicit user action.
feature_families.output_exit: Existing path, moved app, signature/notarization/update mismatch, interrupted update, rollback, and incompatible architecture fail visibly.
acceptance: safe CLI install/upgrade/uninstall and moved-app handling
feature_families.evidence_limit: Only development packaging and a symlink installer exist; no updater or production release was exercised.

feature_families.name: Localization
feature_families.cmux_contract: Catalog-backed user-visible strings pass structure, default, lint, plural, placeholder, and omission checks across product surfaces.
zmux_evidence: User-facing Swift, CLI, and web strings are English literals; no string catalog or localization workflow found.
feature_families.target_resolution: Current locale with documented fallback across native, CLI, web, email, and extension contexts.
feature_families.focus_policy: not applicable
feature_families.output_exit: Missing keys, placeholders, plurals, or unsupported locale fall back safely and fail CI where required.

feature_families.name: Reliability and numeric resource gates
feature_families.cmux_contract: Every budget names hardware, OS, build, workload, measurement method, threshold, exact SHA, and cleanup result; a different stack alone is not stability evidence.
zmux_evidence: Focused model and control-plane source tests exist.
crates/session-runtime/tests/lifecycle.rs:60 proves an output flood does not prevent cancellation and leader reaping.
crates/session-runtime/tests/lifecycle.rs:114 proves saturated input returns backpressure without blocking cancellation.
No approved numeric Mac budget, measured multi-session fairness result, or remote/provider/mobile soak was found.
feature_families.target_resolution: Exact packaged build and exact local, browser, remote, provider, VPN, or mobile workload.
feature_families.focus_policy: Measurements include foreground and background behavior without synthetic focus hiding stalls.
feature_families.output_exit: Budget failure, leak, starvation, reconnect loss, and unavailable measurement are recorded rather than converted to a pass.
feature_families.evidence_limit: No native measurement or remote soak was run in this audit.
